svg.desc: Wide vector wallpaper in the Frutiger Metro style of the late 2000s. A graceful adult woman in profile, shown from the waist up as one solid dark plum silhouette, with a clearly readable face profile and long flowing hair, positioned on the right third. Bold floral swirls, small daisies, circles and starbursts frame her. Flat solid colors: magenta, coral, orange, plum and pale blush. Smooth clean curves, crisp edges, no texture or outlines. Leave the left two-thirds mostly pale blush negative space for software content. Full bleed background, no text, logos, borders or interface elements.
